name: Nova Vivienne Monroe
source:
A [s]burnt-out[/s] sculptor who used to live in a beach town with her grandmother as a child. She inherits four mysterious glass orbs, the titular ocean pearls, from her grandmother. Nova realizes neither the origin nor the significance of the pearls, much less where her grandmother got them from but they are the catalyst that will get her unavoidably engaged to an ocean king.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=36495]Lemma Soft Forum[/url]]
